## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`, `chore: …`)
- [ ] Implemented means documented: `docs/` (plan status, stack, APIs, ADRs) and READMEs are updated
- [ ] New behavior has unit tests (`pnpm test` passes), or the PR explains why it cannot
- [ ] Code, comments, docs and commits are in English; new UI text is in both catalogs (`apps/web/src/messages/`)
